objective: Systematically select new primary GPS/GNSS public source archives for an independent solar azimuth macroecological sampling frame. No previous-study ecological effect sizes or new azimuth responses enter selection.

registry_eligibility.note: Reported positions and animals are public registry metadata only; do not equate these thresholds with actual qualified GPS animal-years.

strata: Within metadata-qualified candidates, use 2x2 strata based on one vs multiple DISTINCT literal scientific-name labels and reported animal count <30 vs >=30.
selection: Rank each stratum by ascending SHA256 UTF8('odsp-azimuth-public-20261025-v1:'+package_uuid) and retain exactly the first THREE package UUIDs. No replacement for failed sources, ambiguous primary GPS files, poor cadence, unsupported time zone, fewer than five qualified animals, or uninteresting effects.

file_preflight.if_ambiguous_or_unavailable: SOURCE_HOLD; never substitute next ranked source

biological_follow_on.source_id_and_doi: registry exact sample; record study-ID overlaps against all 259 original sensor-labelled packages
biological_follow_on.taxon: Source-original individual-taxon-canonical-name must match registry when multi-taxon; single taxon source may lack row taxon column
biological_follow_on.utc_schema: Original columns timestamp, location-lat, location-long, individual-local-identifier required; do not guess or repair source clock/tz after effects.
biological_follow_on.hourly_rule: Within each animal and original UTC hour, choose nearest start-of-hour source fix on timestamp only (never heading).
biological_follow_on.geometry_and_outcomes: Reuse scripts/solar_azimuth_macro_v0.py unchanged, including 0.5-2h step, 0.1km displacement floor, sun elevation >=10 at endpoint/midpoint, circular raw/compass/clock covariance, animal-year/animal equal weighting.
biological_follow_on.output: All twelve source entries, all source-native taxa and counts; original GPS coordinates, per-animal identities and timestamps must not leave runner.
biological_follow_on.no_global_effect_claim: Source package is not an independent biological region; source-specific wild/domestic taxon, migration, sensor and terrain confounds unresolved.
